info.title: Almohit App API
info.description:
Customer and mobile API on Odoo (`almohit_core` 17.0.1.48.0).

**Authentication.** The only method is the Odoo `session_id` cookie (`HttpOnly`, `Path=/`). `POST /almohit/api/auth/login` authenticates and sets `Set-Cookie: session_id=<final rotated session>`. JSON responses do not include `session_id`. There is no Bearer token and no JWT.

Missing, invalid, expired, or logged-out session on protected `/almohit/api/` routes returns HTTP 401 JSON `AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` (not a 303 HTML redirect to `/web/login`). `/auth/me` and `/auth/logout` are public routes and return `UNAUTHENTICATED` when no session is present.

**Roles.** Merchant (external customer who buys FROM Almohit): cart, checkout, customer orders, invoices, payments, payment transactions, addresses. Buyer (Almohit procurement who buys FROM farmers/suppliers INTO inventory): `/almohit/api/buyer/*` only — suppliers, procurement products, purchase orders, incoming receipts. Marketer: recruited-merchant APIs (approved marketer required). Distributor: delivery APIs (approved distributor required). All four roles: own trade application. Public: catalog, currencies, health, register, login.

Wrong role on a protected route returns 403 `ACCESS_DENIED`. Buyer is denied customer commerce. Merchant/marketer/distributor are denied buyer procurement. Cart, checkout, marketer, and delivery routes that require wholesale approval return 403 `WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` when the partner is not approved. Price is omitted from catalog unless `partner.almohit_trade_status == approved` (not role-based).

**Buyer procurement.** Native `res.partner` vendors (`supplier_rank > 0`), `product.template`/`product.product`, `purchase.order`, and incoming `stock.picking`. Confirm uses `purchase.order.button_confirm()`. Receive uses `stock.picking.button_validate()` after setting done quantities. Portal Buyer + sudo after `group_almohit_buyer`. Purchases are scoped to `purchase.order.user_id` of the current Buyer.

**Checkout.** `POST /checkout` confirms the storefront `sale.order` (`action_confirm`). It does not create an invoice. Confirmed orders typically have `invoice_status` of `to invoice` and `invoices: []` until staff invoicing.

**Ownership.** Another customer's order, invoice, payment, transaction, address, or delivery is returned as the matching `*_NOT_FOUND` 404. Foreign record existence is not exposed.

**Envelope.** Success `{ ok: true, data }`. Error `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }` (extra fields may be flattened onto `error`). Paginated lists put `{ items, pagination }` inside `data`.

**Catalog list.** `GET /almohit/api/products` is paginated. `data` is `{ items, pagination }`, not a raw array. Default `page=1`, `page_size=20` (max 100). `GET /almohit/api/products/{id}`, `GET /almohit/api/categories`, and `GET /almohit/api/brands` are not paginated (`categories` and `brands` remain raw arrays in `data`).

**JSON image uploads** (trade shop image, marketer shop image, admin product/gallery/variant/brand, buyer procurement product, buyer purchase images). MIME allowlist: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`. GIF, SVG, and PDF are rejected. Limits use decoded bytes, not Base64 string length. Product/gallery/variant/brand/buyer product/purchase images: 2 MB. Shop image: 4 MB. Max 2000×2000. Purchase `images` max 12. Errors: `INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE`, `INVALID_IMAGE_DATA`, `IMAGE_TOO_LARGE`, `IMAGE_DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE` (HTTP 400). Gallery count over 12 still returns `INVALID_IMAGE`.

sessionCookie.name: session_id
sessionCookie.description: Odoo session cookie set by POST /almohit/api/auth/login via Set-Cookie. This is the only authentication method. Not a JWT.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number. Default 1. Invalid values return 400 INVALID_PAGINATION.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Page size 1..100. Default 20. Invalid values return 400 INVALID_PAGINATION.

DateFrom.name: date_from
DateFrom.description: Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Invalid date or date_from > date_to returns 400 INVALID_FILTER.

SortNewestOldest.name: sort
SortNewestOldest.description: Optional. Unknown values return 400 INVALID_SORT. Omitted uses the endpoint default (usually id desc; addresses default to type, id).

trade_status.description: Partner almohit_trade_status, e.g. normal, pending, approved, rejected.

address.description: Alias for street when street is omitted.

shop_image_base64.description: Optional Base64. Decoded size max 4 MB. Max 2000×2000. Not validated by Base64 string length.

shop_image_content_type.description: Required when shop_image_base64 is sent. GIF, SVG, and PDF are rejected as INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE.

status.description: Write actions only. List filter also accepts pending, waiting, cancelled.

address.description: Alias for street when street is omitted.

shop_image_base64.description: Optional Base64. Decoded size max 4 MB. Max 2000×2000.

shop_image_content_type.description: Required when shop_image_base64 is sent. GIF, SVG, and PDF are rejected as INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE.

latitude.description: Optional merchant latitude. Stored in res.partner.partner_latitude.

longitude.description: Optional merchant longitude. Stored in res.partner.partner_longitude.

qty_available.description: Included only for approved partners (price-visible). Catalog list/detail omit it otherwise.

price.description: Omitted unless the session partner has almohit_trade_status approved.

transaction_id.description: Present on invoice payment start only.

payment_flow.description: Present on invoice payment start only. Secrets stripped.

standard_cost.description: Native standard_price. Not a sales pricelist price.

AuthRequired.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or logged-out session on an auth=user route.

AccessDenied.description: Authenticated but wrong Almohit role group (ACCESS_DENIED), unapproved where required (WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED), or related 403.

BadRequest.description: Validation error (INVALID_FIELDS, INVALID_PAGINATION, INVALID_FILTER, INVALID_SORT, and endpoint-specific codes).

NotFound.description: Owned record not found, including another customer's record.

200.description: `data` is `{ company_currency, date, currencies: [{ id, code, name, symbol, decimal_places, rate_from_company, is_company }] }`.

get.description:
Public. `price` and `availability.qty_available` are included only when the request session belongs to a partner with `almohit_trade_status == approved`. Not role-based.

`q` searches template name, default_code, barcode, and variant default_code/barcode.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Positive integer. Else 400 INVALID_FILTER. Exact `categ_id` match unless `include_children=true`.

parameters.name: include_children
parameters.description: Default false. Requires `category_id`. `true` uses Odoo `categ_id child_of` (selected category and descendants). `false` or omitted keeps exact `categ_id =`. Else 400 INVALID_FILTER. Sending `include_children` without `category_id` is 400 INVALID_FILTER.

parameters.name: min_moq
parameters.description: Inclusive. Products with `almohit_min_order_qty >= min_moq`. Number >= 0. Else 400 INVALID_FILTER. If greater than `max_moq`, 400 INVALID_FILTER.

parameters.name: max_moq
parameters.description: Inclusive. Products with `almohit_min_order_qty <= max_moq`. Number >= 0. Else 400 INVALID_FILTER.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Inclusive partner-pricelist price cap (the card `price`, not `list_price`). Number >= 0. Else 400 INVALID_FILTER. Products without a price are omitted. Approved session required; else 403 WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. There is no `min_price`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default `name, id`. `newest`/`oldest` use `create_date` then `id`. `price_asc`/`price_desc` sort by the partner pricelist price shown on the card (not `list_price`). Approved session required; else 403 WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Products without a price sort last. Else 400 INVALID_SORT.

200.description: `data` is `{ items, pagination }`, not a raw product array. Default page=1, page_size=20, max page_size=100.

403.description: WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED when `max_price` is sent or `sort` is `price_asc`/`price_desc` and the session partner is not approved.

get.description: Public. Same price/qty visibility as the list. Detail also includes `description` and `barcode`.

200.description: Single product template in `data` (not paginated). Includes `description` and `barcode`.
`data` is an array of `{ id, name, complete_name, parent_id }`.

get.description: Public. Returns `{ id, name }` for `almohit.product.brand` records assigned to at least one active `sale_ok` product template. Unused brands are omitted. Ordered name asc, id asc. Not paginated.

200.description: `data` is an array of `{ id, name }`.

post.description: Creates a portal user. Does not start a session — call login next. Allowlist: name, email, password, phone, role.

400.description: INVALID_JSON, INVALID_FIELDS, NAME_REQUIRED, INVALID_ROLE, EMAIL_REQUIRED, PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT

post.description: Authenticates and sets the HttpOnly `session_id` cookie. JSON `data` is the user only — it does not include `session_id`. Allowlist: email, password.

200.description: Authenticated user. Session is the Set-Cookie `session_id`, not a JSON field.

400.description: INVALID_JSON, INVALID_FIELDS, or INVALID_CREDENTIALS when email/password missing.

get.description: Public route. Returns the authenticated user/account only (no `session_id` in JSON). Unauthenticated response is 401 UNAUTHENTICATED (not AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED).

post.description: Requires a valid session. Unauthenticated: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. Success: `{ logged_out: true }`.
Buyer, merchant, marketer, and distributor. Own application only.

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, COMPANY_NAME_REQUIRED, INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE, INVALID_IMAGE_DATA, IMAGE_TOO_LARGE, IMAGE_DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD, INVALID_ROLE

get.description: Buyer, merchant, marketer, and distributor. `data` may be null.
Approved merchant only. Buyer, marketer, and distributor: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. Unapproved merchant: 403 WHOLESALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

post.description: Allowlist: product_id, quantity. Below MOQ returns 400 MIN_ORDER_QUANTITY_NOT_MET with error.min_order_qty.

get.description: Merchant only. All `res.country` records, ordered by name then id. Not paginated. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED.

200.description: `data` is an array of `{ id, name, code }`.

get.description: Merchant only. `res.country.state` records for the given country, ordered by name then id. Not paginated. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED.

parameters.name: country_id
parameters.description: Required positive integer. Missing or invalid: 400 INVALID_COUNTRY. Unknown country: 404 COUNTRY_NOT_FOUND.

200.description: `data` is an array of `{ id, name, code, country_id }`.

get.description: Merchant only. `q` searches name, street, street2, city, zip, phone. Default order is type, id. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED.

post.description: Allowlist: type, name, street, street2, city, zip, phone, state_id, country_id, country_code. Country is required (country_id or country_code).

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, INVALID_ADDRESS, ADDRESS_TYPE_INVALID, NAME_REQUIRED, STREET_REQUIRED, CITY_REQUIRED, COUNTRY_REQUIRED, COUNTRY_NOT_FOUND, STATE_NOT_FOUND, STATE_COUNTRY_MISMATCH

patch.description: Same allowlist as create. Partial updates allowed. Another customer's address: 404 ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND.

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, INVALID_ADDRESS, and address validation codes.

post.description:
Approved merchant only. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. Confirms the storefront sale.order (`action_confirm`). Does **not** create an invoice. Typical result: `state=sale`, `invoice_status=to invoice`, `invoices=[]` until staff invoicing.

Allowlist: shipping_address_id, invoice_address_id.

200.description: Confirmed order (serialize_order). No invoice is created by this call.

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, INVALID_CHECKOUT, CART_EMPTY, ADDRESS_TYPE_INVALID, MIN_ORDER_QUANTITY_NOT_MET, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, PRICELIST_REQUIRED, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, CHECKOUT_FAILED

get.description: Merchant only. Own storefront sale orders. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. `q` searches name and client_order_ref. Dates filter `date_order`.
Another customer's order returns 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND.
Merchant only. Invoices linked to own storefront orders. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. `q` searches name and payment_reference. Dates filter `invoice_date`.
Another customer's invoice returns 404 INVOICE_NOT_FOUND.

post.summary: Start online payment for an invoice
post.description: Allowlist: provider_id. Returns a transaction plus `payment_flow` (secrets stripped).

get.description: Merchant only. Posted inbound customer payments reconciled to own invoices. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. `q` searches name and ref. Dates filter payment `date`.
Another customer's payment returns 404 PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND.
Merchant only. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: When set, amount/currency come from that owned invoice residual. Unknown invoice: 404 INVOICE_NOT_FOUND.

200.description: `data` is an array of `{ id, code, name, state }`.

get.description: Merchant only. Buyer: 403 ACCESS_DENIED. `q` searches reference. Dates filter `create_date`.
Another customer's transaction returns 404 TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND.
Approved distributor only. `q` searches picking name, origin, and sale order name. Dates filter `scheduled_date`. Status maps API values to native picking states.
Unassigned or another distributor's picking returns 404 DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Allowlist: status. Write values: ready, delivered (400 INVALID_DELIVERY_STATUS otherwise).

get.description: Approved marketer only. `q` searches company_name, tax_number, phone, partner email. Dates filter `create_date`.

post.description: Creates a portal merchant and a trade application, then automatically approves it for an approved marketer. Coordinates are optional and stored on the merchant's res.partner. Allowlist: name, email, password, phone, company_name, tax_number, business_type, street, address, city, manager_name, employee_name, bank_account, payment_method, notes, shop_image_base64, shop_image_content_type, latitude, longitude.

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, NAME_REQUIRED, EMAIL_REQUIRED, PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT, COMPANY_NAME_REQUIRED, INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE, INVALID_IMAGE_DATA, IMAGE_TOO_LARGE, IMAGE_DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD, INVALID_LOCATION

get.description: Buyer only (`group_almohit_buyer`). Company vendors with `supplier_rank > 0`. `q` searches name, phone, mobile, email, vat.

post.description: Buyer only. Server sets `supplier_rank=1`, `customer_rank=0`, and company. `tax_number` maps to `vat`. Unknown fields: 400 INVALID_FIELDS.

get.description: Buyer only (`group_almohit_buyer`). Active `uom.uom` records, ordered by category, name, then id. Not paginated.

200.description: `data` is an array of `{ id, name, category: { id, name }, uom_type, rounding }`.

get.description: Buyer only. `product.product` with `purchase_ok`. Does not return sales pricelist prices. Category/brand lookup remains `GET /categories` and `GET /brands`.

post.description: Buyer only. Native `product.template`/`product.product`. Server sets `purchase_ok=true` and `sale_ok=true` so the item can later be sold to merchants. Default type is storable `product`. Does not accept list_price, standard_price, stock quantities, taxes, or company_id.

400.description: INVALID_FIELDS, NAME_REQUIRED, CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND, BRAND_NOT_FOUND, UOM_NOT_FOUND, image errors

get.description: `product_id` is `product.product` id.
Buyer only. Scoped to `purchase.order.user_id` of the current user. `q` searches name, vendor name, partner_ref.

post.description: Buyer only. Native `purchase.order`. Server sets `user_id` to the current Buyer. Currency is derived from the vendor/company. Optional `images` (max 12) uses JPEG/PNG/WebP. Unknown fields including company_id, user_id, state, amount_total: 400 INVALID_FIELDS.

get.description: Another buyer's purchase returns 404 PURCHASE_NOT_FOUND. Detail includes `image_count` and `images` with URLs under `/almohit/api/buyer/purchases/{id}/images/{image_id}`.

patch.description: Allowed only in native editable states: draft, sent, to approve. Optional `images` (max 12). Confirmed: 400 PURCHASE_NOT_EDITABLE.

post.description: Calls native `purchase.order.button_confirm()`. Creates incoming `stock.picking` via purchase_stock. Does not write `state` directly.

get.description: Returns an image attached to a purchase order owned by the current Buyer.
Buyer only. Incoming pickings linked to the current Buyer's purchase orders. `status=ready` is accepted as native `assigned`.
Another buyer's receipt returns 404 RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Buyer only. Sets native done quantities then `stock.picking.button_validate()`. Partial quantities follow native backorder. Does not write `qty_available` or `stock.quant`.

200.description: Updated receipt, including backorders when created.
